_comment: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Reproduces the actual incident: Renan published FIVE gallery photographs on the Drainage service document (service-drainage-external-pipe-repairs in the real dataset), and the frontend rendered only three — ServiceBody.tsx required an exact gallery[1]+gallery[2] pair and silently dropped everything from gallery[3] onward. This fixture gives a core service a five-item gallery and proves all five now render, in the lightbox as well as on the page. Paired with service-gallery-four.json, which removes the fifth, to prove a removal actually reduces the rendered count rather than the frontend having cached or hardcoded five.
